exposure: Fasting glucose (FG) levels in early pregnancy
cohort: The study included 39,483 deliveries, specifically focusing on 12,918 pregnant women with risk factors for gestational diabetes who underwent an oral glucose tolerance test before 24 weeks of gestation.
finding: Early pregnancy glycaemic levels in women with risk factors for gestational diabetes are positively associated with an increased risk of various pregnancy complications, even at levels below the current diagnostic criteria for GDM.
mod_finding: Early pregnancy hyperglycaemia was associated with an increased risk of primary Caesarean section.
